sql: select 'INTEGRITY' as what, ie.kind||' / '||ie.severity as k,   concat(ie.detected_at::text,' | ',coalesce(left(ie.description,160),'-')) as v   from experiment_integrity_events ie where ie.resolved_at is null union all select 'ORDER', o.market_ticker,   concat(o.created_at::text,' st=',coalesce(o.status,'-'),' px=',coalesce(o.limit_price::text,'-'),  ' qty=',coalesce(o.quantity::text,'-'))   from live_orders o where o.strategy='Emmsell10' and (    o.market_ticker like '%26SEP06PAUALC%' or     o.market_ticker like '%26SEP061310ATLPHI%' or     o.market_ticker like '%26SEP061340CHCMIA%') order by 1,2,3
